name: Feilong Auto Components Co., Ltd.
summary: Feilong Auto Components Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, process, manufactures, and sells auto parts in China and internationally. It offers automotive water pumps, electronic water pumps, temperature control modules, turbocharger housing and volutes, engine intake and exhaust manifolds, oil pump, vacuum and electronic compressor, and flywheel housings. The company also offers electric pump series, thermostatic valve series, integrated thermal management modules; commercial (ict, idc, charging and storage) liquid-cooled pumps, robot liquid-cooled pumps and terminal liquid-cooled pumps; thermal management integration and electronic temperature control valves and electronic actuators…
